meta.description: Braspaña Sabores, a Brazilian café and bakery in Vilanova i la Geltrú. Pastel de feira, coxinha, caldo de cana, tapioca and açaí, all made to order. Open Monday to Saturday from 6:00.

brand.sub: Brazilian bakery · Vilanova i la Geltrú

hero.title:
A taste of Brazil,
made to order.
hero.lede: Crisp pastel de feira, coxinha straight from the fryer, ice-cold caldo de cana and coffee the way it's made back home. In Vilanova i la Geltrú, from six in the morning.

about.title:
Real Brazilian food,
just around the corner.
about.p1: Braspaña began with saudade: that very specific longing for a pastel de feira pulled hot from the oil, a glass of ice-cold caldo de cana, a coxinha that tastes exactly the way it should.
about.p2: Everything here is made to order, in small batches, the way it's done in Brazil. No shortcuts and nothing from the freezer — just dough, filling, and someone frying it for you when you ask.
about.note: We open at 6:00, Monday to Saturday.
about.typeValue: Coffee shop and Brazilian food store

specialties.title: What comes out of the fryer

pastel.title: Pastel de feira
pastel.text: Thin, crisp pastry fried to order. The classic of every Brazilian market, and big enough that you won't finish it.

coxinha.title: Coxinha
coxinha.text: Shredded chicken wrapped in cassava dough, breaded and fried. Shaped like a teardrop, the way it should be.

caldo.title: Caldo de cana
caldo.text: Sugar cane pressed to order and served properly cold. Sweet, light, and impossible to fake.

tapioca.title: Tapioca recheada
tapioca.text: A cassava-starch flatbread with whatever filling you like. Gluten free and ready in a minute.

acai.title: Açaí
acai.text: Thick açaí with fruit and granola. Cold, dense, with the flavour of northern Brazil.

cafe.title: Brazilian coffee
cafe.text: Real coffee, served the Brazilian way: small, hot and without ceremony.
